cleanup_only.description: If true, skip backup and run only cleanup actions.

duplicity_include.description: Space-separated duplicity include patterns (e.g., '+ /etc + /var/www - /**'). Uses duplicity’s include/exclude syntax.

duplicity_options_file.description: Path to a file with additional duplicity options (one per line).

env_vars.description: Key-value pairs of environment variables to export before backup (e.g., for cloud provider credentials).

exclude_patterns.description: List of file/directory patterns to exclude using glob-style wildcards (e.g., '*.log', '/var/cache/*'). Each pattern becomes a separate `--exclude` rule.

items.description: Glob or path pattern to exclude.

full_backup.description: If true, force a full backup (overrides automatic incremental logic).

full_backup_days.description: Force a full backup every N days (if not already done).

gpg_key_id.description: GnuPG key ID (e.g., 0x1234ABCD) for encrypting/decrypting backups.

gpg_passphrase.description: GPG passphrase (plaintext). Use only in secure, local deployments. Prefer `gpg_passphrase_file` instead.

gpg_passphrase_file.description: Absolute path to a file containing only the GPG passphrase (more secure).

max_age.description: Maximum age of backups to retain (e.g., '1Y' for one year, '3M' for three months). Empty = no automatic cleanup.

max_count.description: Maximum number of backup sets to keep. Empty = no limit.

max_parallel.description: Number of parallel file operations for cloud backends (0 = auto-detect).

no_full.description: If true, disable automatic full backups — only incrementals.

post_backup_cmd.description: Shell command to run after backup (e.g., `notify-send 'Backup done'`).

pre_backup_cmd.description: Shell command to run before backup (e.g., `mysqldump --all-databases > /tmp/db.sql`).

profile_name.description: Name of the duply profile (also the directory name under /etc/duply/).

source_dir.description: Top-level directory or file to back up.

target_url.description: Backup target URL (e.g., s3://my-bucket/duply, file:///mnt/backup). Required.

verify.description: If true, verify the last backup before running cleanup.

volsize.description: Maximum size (in MB) of each volume in a multipart backup. Example: '200' (200 MB).
